transcript.answer: Pull request #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It closed issue #474 and was merged on 2026-10-23. Before it, #179 (PR #438) only checked FALLBACK_MODEL_ID against the allowlist and printed it in the api.model startup line. The fallback never reached the engine, because buildEngine passed no fallbackProviders. PR #475 added supportAgentProviders(config) in apps/api/src/server.ts. It returns the resolved fallback in fallbackProviders, or an empty list when FALLBACK_MODEL_ID is unset, and buildEngine spreads it into createHalEngine.
